intro: Field Marshal Stonebridge is a high-ranking Alliance officer stationed near the entrance of Stormwind City. Posted beside the Gates of Stormwind in the Valley of Heroes, she oversees city defenses alongside General Marcus Jonathan and serves as an authority for major martial triumphs.

p: Positioned just inside the towering entrance of the Valley of Heroes, Field Marshal Stonebridge stands watch beneath the eastern archway near the main gates. Her high rank within the Grand Alliance military places her among the highest echelons of Stormwind's strategic leadership, operating in close coordination with General Marcus Jonathan. From this prominent vantage, she observes the flow of defenders, travelers, and returning champions passing into the capital, standing ready to organize the garrison should threats breach the outer perimeter.

Beyond her ceremonial and defensive duties at the city gate, Field Marshal Stonebridge receives critical reports and spoils from campaigns against the greatest adversaries threatening the kingdom. High-ranking commanders rely on officers like Stonebridge to verify crucial intelligence and celebrate monumental victories won in the field, including the defeat of warlords and monsters nesting within the crags of Blackrock Mountain.
